Business

The business form enables administrators to rename a business file within the system.

This form provides a secure way to change how a business is identified throughout the application.

Access Restrictions

Only users with administrative privileges can access and use this form to rename businesses.

Restricted users can view the form but cannot make changes. They will see a read-only version with a message explaining that only administrators can rename business files.

Renaming Process

When you rename a business, the system automatically updates the business file name on disk and adjusts all associated user permissions.

The rename operation includes validation to ensure the new name contains only valid characters and does not conflict with existing business files.

If an error occurs during the rename process, such as a file access issue, an error message will be displayed and the original name will be preserved.
